# AspectCut

> AspectCut is a free, browser-based video aspect ratio changer that processes files locally with WebCodecs; videos are not uploaded to a server.

## Overview
AspectCut enables video creators to reframe landscape (16:9), vertical (9:16), square (1:1), and portrait (4:5) videos directly inside modern web browsers. Using the browser's built-in WebCodecs engine, all video decompression, frame compositing (focal cropping, blurred mirror background extensions, letterboxing), and H.264 rendering occur entirely within client memory. Video data is never transmitted to an external server.

## Core Tools & Interactive Calculators
- [Video Aspect Ratio Changer](https://aspectcut.com/): Free client-side video aspect ratio changer and reframer with zero server uploads and no watermarks.
